diagnosis: The bot is basically break-even/slightly negative (50.7% WR, -$68.37 over 404 trades), with the losses concentrated in a specific, now-identifiable failure mode: MOMENTUM entries on 'move10-20' bps signals (-$33.47, 28/81=34.6% WR) and 'left60-120' seconds-remaining entries (-$20.25, 21/59=35.6% WR), both already validated and vetoed/flagged but the recent decision log shows the veto is working (correctly skipping move10-20 setups repeatedly). ARB is a tiny but clearly profitable edge (92% WR, +$5.89 over 13 trades) that is underutilized. DOGE (-$23.45, 39% WR) and ETH (-$25.40, 54% WR but still net negative) are the worst coin-level performers, while BTC is the only clearly profitable coin (+$10.83, 60% WR). The 'all-agree' peer-consensus bucket is paradoxically losing money (-$18.99, 44.6% WR) despite being flagged reduce_confidence already — this suggests momentum_min_confidence and peer-agreement logic are not discriminating well; high consensus does not predict direction in this chop regime. The 'left<60' bucket is a disaster (-$19.40, 15.4% WR) confirming late-window entries are toxic, consistent with min_entry_left_sec=150 already filtering some of this, but the historical sample pre-dates that fix. The bot is in a sideways/choppy 5-min crypto regime where small momentum moves (10-20bps) are mostly noise, and entries deep into the window are being caught by mean-reversion. The core edge computation (edge = ask-derived, ~0.02-0.10) is not translating into realized profit at paying prices of 0.55-0.65 ask, which the lessons confirm: 'price0.55-0.70' bucket is -$7.21 (51% WR) — a thin, roughly breakeven edge being eaten by fees/slippage. Overall the system is a slight net loser that has improved via lesson-vetoes but still bleeds on DOGE/XRP/SOL and on 'some-agree' and 'all-agree' partial-consensus momentum trades.
